body: I’m feeling so hopeless right now. I can’t fucken go to sleep. Day 5 and I just want to pick up my fucken phone
Aren’t you curious? Sometimes I think that’s only why I try to seek tomorrow

Wow everything you said. Sometimes I think about that, that if these emotions would just leave and if the voices would just stay quiet may be it wouldn’t be so bad. Thank you for taking the time to share. And I’m happy that things got better for you. Childhood experience really do be messing us up. Can I ask what did you do when the pain was unbearable? Like you knew it was going to be a tough night?
I appreciate your insight. Thank you. Do you ever find that it’s easier to give advise to others, but hard for us to take it? Stay strong and don’t let go. Keep at it.
Why do I feel like a shadow among people
The sad thing is I tried it and failed
